$description: MetalUI gadgets: the catalog an assistant composes gadgets and rigs from. Specs are JSON (metalui/gadget@1, metalui/rig@1), validated by validateGadget and validateRig, drawn by <Gadget> and <Rig> (React) and MetalGadget and MetalRig (SwiftUI).

press.caption: The keys drop into their skirts one after another and spring back: a chord.

slide.caption: Caps travel along their slots to a new mix, one after another; they scrape as they go, tick past each detent, and knock if they reach the end.

seat.caption: The plug lifts, its shadow opens, and it seats again with a click.

turn.caption: The ring turns to the value, clicking at every eighth of a turn; taken, it clicks round one and back.

flip.caption: The lid swings about its hinge: it creaks as it rises, and thuds shut against the rim. Emptied, it swings open and slams.

sweep.caption: The beam turns once around the glass; each blip lights as the beam crosses it, and fades.

roll.caption: The drums turn to the new count, the lowest first; each ticks past its digits and settles with a small knock.

swing.caption: The needle swings to the value, overshoots a little and settles; at the ends of its scale it bounces off the pegs.

glow.caption: Light rises behind the resin: the cells light in turn from the bottom row up, and the backlight brightens with them.

slide-out.caption: The drawer is pulled out toward you on its runners, stops against them, is held a moment, and springs home.

dip.caption: The nib dips into its well and springs back up, with a soft tap on the well.

ports.number: a value between `min` and `max`, with a `unit`
ports.boolean: a switch; named after a state, it puts the gadget in that state
ports.state: one of `options`; it sets the gadget's state
ports.pulse: an event, never stored; into a gadget it plays its act

maps.threshold: a number or count at or past `at` becomes `above`, else `below` (a word or a switch)
maps.scale: a number mapped linearly from `from` [a, b] onto `to` [c, d]
maps.match: a word or switch equal to `when` becomes a pulse
maps.count: a pulse adds `step` (1 or -1) to the count already at the far port
maps.select: a word or switch looked up in `table` (keys are words, "true" or "false"): a word, a number or a switch

gadgets.name: patch-bay
gadgets.title: Sync
gadgets.description: A gadget for sync: two jacks in a stone slab, a cord between their plugs, a lamp and a beeper. Drawn at runtime from its spec by the gadget renderer.

gadgets.name: fader-bank
gadgets.title: Settings
gadgets.description: A gadget for settings: three fader caps in slots cut into a pale warm-grey clay slab, the one you would touch in orange, and a lamp. One value moves the whole bank; the caps scrape, tick past detents and knock at the ends. Drawn at runtime from its spec.

gadgets.name: keycap-chord
gadgets.title: Shortcuts
gadgets.description: A gadget for shortcuts: two keys, ⌘ and K, standing in a tray sunk into a ceramic slab, the one you would press in orange, and a lamp. Its act is a chord: the keys drop one after another and spring back, with two ceramic tinks and higher clicks on the way up. Drawn at runtime from its spec.

gadgets.name: scope
gadgets.title: Search
gadgets.description: A gadget for search: an ice-glass radar face sunk in a stone bezel. While it searches, a beam sweeps the glass and blips light as it crosses them, with a glass tick each; found, the blips stay lit. Drawn at runtime from its spec.

gadgets.name: drawer
gadgets.title: Storage
gadgets.description: A gadget for what is kept: a pale steel filing drawer under a steel top, with a metal pull and a lamp. Its index cards stand to how full it is; filing one slides it out on its runners and home again, and full, it will not close. Drawn at runtime from its spec.

gadgets.name: lidded-bin
gadgets.title: Trash
gadgets.description: A gadget for throwing away: a heavy near-black rubber lid over a bin's mouth, on a rubber slab, and a lamp. Armed, the lid rises ajar showing its red underside and the lamp goes red; emptied, it swings open and slams shut with a thud. Drawn at runtime from its spec.

gadgets.name: shutter-lens
gadgets.title: Capture
gadgets.description: A gadget for capture: a lens with a knurled accent ring in a warm clay bezel around glass lit from behind, and a lamp. Taken, the ring clicks round a detent and back, the glass flashes and the lamp flickers; its ring's angle is a zoom value. Drawn at runtime from its spec.

gadgets.name: counter-drum
gadgets.title: Streak
gadgets.description: A gadget for a streak: three numbered drums in a window sunk into a clay slab, the units drum in orange, and a lamp. The count turns the drums like an odometer, the lowest first, ticking past each digit and settling with a small knock. Drawn at runtime from its spec.

gadgets.name: cell-grid
gadgets.title: Memory
gadgets.description: A gadget for something kept that fills: sixteen translucent resin cells in a tray sunk into a resin slab, lit from behind, and a lamp. A share lights the cells in turn from the bottom row up and the light behind them brightens with them; on a first run the whole grid rises. Drawn at runtime from its spec.

gadgets.name: needle-gauge
gadgets.title: Today
gadgets.description: A gadget for a level: a needle over a printed scale in peach glass, sunk in a copper metal bezel, with a lamp and a beeper on its frame. A value swings the needle, which overshoots a little and settles; past the threshold the gauge is over and says so. Drawn at runtime from its spec.

gadgets.name: rocker
gadgets.title: Sound
gadgets.description: A gadget for one setting: a rocker in the accent sunk in a well in a pale clay slab, and a lamp. On, its upper end (I) is pressed and the lamp lit; off, its lower end (O). It rocks on the hinge spring and clicks each way. Drawn at runtime from its spec.

gadgets.name: ink-well
gadgets.title: Draw
gadgets.description: A gadget for making: a brass nib over a well of ink in a pale ceramic slab, and a lamp. Drawing starts and the nib dips into the ink with a soft tap, then rests a little lower, writing. Drawn at runtime from its spec.

gadgets.name: thumbwheel
gadgets.title: When
gadgets.description: A gadget for the past: a knurled wheel seen edge-on in a slot in a stone slab, under an engraved NOW, and a lamp. Rolled back it clicks once a day; off now the lamp goes amber, and more than a week back it breathes. Drawn at runtime from its spec.

gadgets.name: glass-badge
gadgets.title: Account
gadgets.description: A gadget for who you are: a person printed on a square of cool glass in a heavy steel bezel, lit from behind, and a lamp. Signed in, the light rises and the lamp rises green; expired, the lamp turns amber. Silent. Drawn at runtime from its spec.
